name: Acolyte
description: You have spent your life in service to a temple or shrine, learning religious traditions.
equipment: A prayer book or prayer wheel
feature: Shelter of the Faithful - You and your companions can receive healing at temples.

name: Charlatan
description: You have learned to escape detection through deception and misdirection.
feature: False Identity - You have a second identity for avoiding detection.

name: Criminal
description: You have experience with crime and know how to evade the law.
feature: Criminal Contact - You have a contact in the criminal underworld.

name: Entertainer
description: You perform for audiences that love your art and can inspire or delight them.
feature: By Popular Demand - You can secure free lodging in return for performances.

name: Folk Hero
description: You come from a humble background and rose to protect common folk from tyrants.
feature: Rustic Hospitality - You can find shelter and aid from common folk.

name: Guild Artisan
description: You are a member of a guild of artisans, skilled in a particular craft.
equipment: Letter of introduction from your guild
feature: Guild Membership - You have connections in the guild and can get resources.

name: Hermit
description: You lived in seclusion for a time, devoting yourself to contemplation.
feature: Discovery - You made a discovery of importance during your seclusion.

name: Noble
description: You were born into a wealthy family with political influence.
feature: Position of Privilege - You are treated with deference in social situations.

name: Outlander
description: You grew up in the wilds, far from civilization.
feature: Wanderer - You can navigate and find food in the wilderness.

name: Sage
description: You spent your life studying arcane knowledge in a great library.
equipment: Letter of introduction from a scholar
feature: Researcher - You know where to find information in academic circles.

name: Sailor
description: You have sailed on the seas and know navigation and maritime life.
feature: Windcatcher's Memory - You can predict weather changes at sea.

name: Soldier
description: You served in a military unit and know warfare and discipline.
feature: Military Rank - You have influence with military organizations.
